{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
filtered_sales = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN (missing)
filtered_sales['customer_age_clean'] = filtered_sales['customer_age'].where(filtered_sales['customer_age'] != -1, other=pd.NA)

# Now compute mean age of customers who converted
mean_age_converted = filtered_sales[filtered_sales['converted'] == 1]['customer_age_clean'].mean()

print('Mean age of customers who converted:', mean_age_converted)"}
